values.note: Standard non-electric site $24 a night in the peak season (2026: May 22 - Sep 6), $15 in the non-peak season (Apr 3 - May 21); group shelter $45-50. Peak $24 unchanged in the 2025-2028 tables.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251959/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-06 STANDARD NONELECTRIC $24; Non-Peak Season 2026-04-03 to 2026-05-21 STANDARD NONELECTRIC $15; 2027-2028 peak $24), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 251959 (every bookable family site typed STANDARD NONELECTRIC; only the host site lists a water hookup) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251959 (notice: 'Please note there is no potable water available at this location'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: recreation.gov lists 17 bookable family sites for RVs, trailers, fifth wheels and tents (plus an unbookable site 013, the host site 012 and a group shelter). No maximum vehicle length is published; listed driveway lengths run 35 to 135 ft (most 50-65). Every site is back-in. One wheeled camper and one tent, or two tents, per site; two vehicles maximum.

sites.source: recreation.gov catalog for 251959 (site types, permitted equipment, Driveway Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251959 (notices: 'limit of 1 wheeled camper and 1 tent per campsite', 'Two vehicles maximum per campsite'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Vault toilet open year round; flush toilets and the dump station only from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day weekend. No potable water.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251959 (Facilities: 'Vault toilet open year round*. Available Starting Memorial Day Weekend - Flush toilets and dump station are available To Labor Day Weekend'; notice: 'there is no potable water available at this location'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777. Walk-ups may take a site that is not reserved, but must check it is free and pay through recreation.gov before parking. 14 nights in any 30 consecutive days at the project. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251959 (notices: 'If you are arriving without a campground reservation, you must pay for camping before you park', 'Please check to make sure the campsite you wish to occupy is not currently reserved', 'Visit Recreation.gov or call 1-877-444-6777 to determine if campsites are open and to pay for open sites'; facility_rules maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed no electric, reservable on rec.gov, $24 peak. Changed fees low 24 -> 15 (the 2026 non-peak season rate), sites count 20 -> 17 (bookable family sites), max_rig_ft 60 -> cleared (from the note; rec.gov publishes only driveway lengths, 35-135 ft). Added no water at sites or potable water, all back-in, vault toilets year round with flush toilets and dump in summer, walk-ups for unreserved sites, 14-night max. Not stated: campground season (rate seasons only), booking window; rec.gov's militaryDiscount rule has no wording, so discounts left alone.
